job.system:
You are the AI assistant for the Coalition Against Deep-Sea Mining. Our staff use you for day-to-day work: research, writing, data, scheduling, and operations.

About us: The Coalition Against Deep-Sea Mining (CADM) is a nonprofit advocacy organization based in Washington, DC. We believe that the industrial mining of the deep seabed, meaning the large-scale extraction of minerals from the ocean floor, poses a serious risk of irreversible destruction to deep-ocean ecosystems, and that no one currently knows how to conduct it without such damage. Our goal is a legally binding prohibition on commercial deep-sea mining, first in the United States and then through an international treaty. We work through lobbying, grassroots organizing, and public education.

Current focus: Our top priority this fall is S. 2817, the Deep Seabed Mining Prohibition Act, which we strongly support. The Senate Commerce Committee will mark up the bill on Thursday, October 15.

You run in our internal chat app, which has no tools, browsing, or code execution, so work everything out directly in your reply. Staff rely on your work, so be accurate and thorough.

# Hill Days Schedule: 78 points

This schedule covers all 8 Tier 1 offices (40 pts), 11 of 13 Tier 2 offices (33 pts), and 5 Tier 3 offices (5 pts). It has 24 meetings in total. I checked every meeting against its window, team availability, walking times, and the lunch rule. I built it by hand and couldn't find anything better, but I haven't proven it's the maximum.

## Itineraries

**Tuesday, Team A (Dana & Luis)**
- 09:30 Rourke (Dirksen, T1)
- 10:15 Okafor (Hart, T1). This is a 10-minute walk from Dirksen, and the meeting ends at the 10:45 window close.
- 10:45 Alvarez (Hart, T2)
- 11:30 Lund (Dirksen, T2). They leave Hart at 11:15 and arrive at 11:25.
- Lunch is 12:00–13:30.
- 13:30 Delgado (Cannon, T2)
- 14:45 Thornton (Longworth, T2)

**Tuesday, Team B (Priya & Sam)**
- 11:15 Boone (Dirksen, T2)
- 12:00 Hale (Russell, T3)
- Lunch is 12:30–14:00.
- 14:00 Whitfield (Russell, T1)
- 14:45 Brandt (Dirksen, T3)
- 15:30 Mercer (Russell, T3)

**Wednesday, Team A (Dana & Luis)**
- 09:00 Lindqvist (Dirksen, T2)
- 09:45 Ellis (Russell, T3)
- 10:30 Barlow (Dirksen, T1)
- 11:30 Montoya (Longworth, T1)
- Lunch is 12:00–13:00.
- 13:00 Fischer (Cannon, T1)
- 13:45 Abernathy (Rayburn, T2)
- 15:00 Pruitt (Cannon, T2). Pruitt has to be Team A, since Team B is gone by 15:00.

**Wednesday, Team B (Priya & Sam)**
- 09:00 Hughes (Longworth, T3)
- 10:00 Gallagher (Hart, T1)
- 10:45 Sandoval (Dirksen, T2)
- 11:30 Stein (Russell, T2)
- Lunch is 12:00–13:45.
- 13:45 Doyle (Russell, T1)
- 14:15 Crowe (Russell, T2). This ends at 14:45, before Team B's 15:00 cutoff.

## Not scheduled
- **Tier 2:** Brooks and Nakamura.
- **Tier 3:** Kessler, Grant, Varga, Iqbal, Vasquez, Osei, Park, Kowalski, Pike, and Haddad.

## Why this works

- **Wednesday afternoon is the bottleneck.** Okafor and Fischer both only work at 13:00 or later on Wednesday, and Doyle is only free at 13:45 sharing that same stretch. Two teams can't cover all three. Moving Okafor to Tuesday at 10:15 solves it, because Team A can reach him from Rourke.
- **Several Tier 2 offices clash on Wednesday afternoon.** Brooks, Pruitt, Abernathy, and Crowe compete for the same hours, and Team A can't do both Pruitt (15:00) and Brooks (15:15). I took Pruitt, Abernathy, and Crowe and dropped Brooks. A swap of Brooks for Pruitt would score the same.
- **Tuesday morning belongs to Team A.** Team B doesn't land until 11:00, so Team A has to cover the 9:30–11:00 window alone. Rourke and Okafor are only in that window, which is why Team A takes them back to back.
